name: ai-efficiency-operating-system
description: Goal-first semantic skill routing, deep research, conditional capability/MCP/runtime forensics, verification, memory, convergence, authorized reverse engineering, autonomy and durable-state workflows for complex ChatGPT and Codex tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Goal-aware auto-routing, deep research and verified execution
interface.longDescription: A lightweight task-goal intelligence gate plus six executive implicit skills, three conditionally auto-invoked specialist skills for capability, MCP/tool-surface and runtime-effect diagnosis, and three explicit-only authority/specialist skills. Uses bounded skill bundles, dynamic/demand loading, deterministic regression routing, fallback graphs and postcondition verification rather than treating installed or connected capabilities as proven usable.
defaultPrompt: Recover my actual goal, select only the skills and tools that materially help, and verify the result.
Diagnose whether the bottleneck is the model, harness, tool surface, permission, session, entitlement, environment or runtime before changing the system.
When many tools or MCP schemas are present, discover and load the smallest relevant capability set instead of inflating context.
If a route fails, preserve the goal, switch to a materially different fallback, and do not claim completion without read-back evidence.
